description: Core dossier check: Fetch a domain's full DNS profile — A, AAAA, NS, SOA, CAA, and TXT records — all in parallel. Use as the first step of a domain audit or when you need a comprehensive DNS snapshot in one call; prefer dns_lookup for a single record type, or dossier_full for all 10 dossier checks at once. Fires six Cloudflare DoH (1.1.1.1) queries concurrently, each with a 5 s timeout. Returns a CheckResult discriminated union: on success, {status:"ok", records:{a, aaaa, ns, soa, caa, txt}}; on failure, {status:"error", reason}.

domain.description: Public FQDN, e.g. example.com. Must be resolvable on the public internet; IPs, ports, paths, and protocol prefixes are rejected.

name: dossier_dns
